# blink
> MEV-protected private mempool infrastructure for wallets and RPC providers across Ethereum, Base, BSC, and Solana.

Blink helps applications protect user transactions from harmful MEV while monetizing benign order flow through private mempool routing and multi-chain RPC infrastructure.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://merkle.io/): Overview of Blink’s MEV protection, private mempool, and order flow monetization platform.
- [About](https://merkle.io/about): Company background, mission, and context for Blink’s infrastructure offering.
- [Support](https://merkle.io/support): Support entry point for users and integrators needing help with Blink.

## Product
- [Private Mempool](https://merkle.io/): Private transaction routing designed to protect users from harmful MEV extraction.
- [Ethereum RPC](https://merkle.io/): Ethereum RPC access with MEV protection and private order flow handling.
- [BSC RPC](https://merkle.io/): BSC RPC infrastructure focused on safe transaction submission and monetization.
- [Multi-Chain Support](https://merkle.io/): Support for Ethereum, Base, BSC, and Solana transaction flow protection.
- [Order Flow Monetization](https://merkle.io/): Infrastructure for converting benign MEV opportunities into wallet and provider revenue.

## Platform Benefits
- [MEV Protection](https://merkle.io/): Protect transactions from frontrunning and other harmful MEV behaviors.
- [Revenue Generation](https://merkle.io/): Monetize order flow while maintaining user safety and execution quality.
- [Superior MEV Extraction](https://merkle.io/): Capture benign MEV efficiently through Blink’s private mempool infrastructure.
- [Risk Reduction](https://merkle.io/): Reduce execution risk and transaction exposure with private routing.
- [Fast Integration](https://merkle.io/): Designed to minimize integration time for wallets and RPC providers.

## Chains
- [Ethereum](https://merkle.io/): MEV-protected transaction flow and RPC support for Ethereum applications.
- [Base](https://merkle.io/): Private mempool support for Base transaction routing and protection.
- [BSC](https://merkle.io/): BSC support for protected order flow and RPC-based integrations.
- [Solana](https://merkle.io/): Solana support for private transaction handling and multi-chain coverage.

- [Wallet Integrations](https://merkle.io/): Blink infrastructure for wallets seeking MEV protection and new revenue streams.
- [RPC Providers](https://merkle.io/): Private mempool and RPC tooling for providers serving protected transaction flow.
- [Transaction Safety](https://merkle.io/): Infrastructure focused on safe settlement across millions of transactions.
- [Private Order Flow](https://merkle.io/): Route transactions privately to reduce exposure and improve execution outcomes.
